source.name: Nestlé Purina News Center – 'Pets on the Pitch: St. Louis CITY SC Introduces Purina as the Team's First Founding Partner'
source.quote: the club today introduced Purina as the team's first founding partner and kit sponsor
source.note: The same release quotes the club's CEO saying Purina would be 'represented on the front of our team's kit'. No deal value for this specific deal has been reported; see the pull request for the league-wide range a local outlet cited.
